TEXT.English: The United States Colored Troops were regiments of African American soldiers organized by the Union during the American Civil War after federal policy opened enlistment. They served in combat, garrison, and support duties, strengthening Union manpower while making military service part of the struggle for emancipation and citizenship.

TEXT.English: The Marine Raiders were United States Marine Corps units formed in 1942 for amphibious raids and operations in the Pacific. Their early-war service emphasized small-unit initiative, reconnaissance, and attacks from the sea before the battalions were reorganized into conventional Marine formations in 1944.
